the whole bar shouting. The center is announced to screen readers as a status.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{StatusBar, Tone, ViewExt};

let bar = StatusBar::new()
    .left((StatusBar::action("Version 1.2"),))
    .center((StatusBar::text("Version 1.3 is available").truncate().grow(1.0), StatusBar::action("Update")))
    .center_tone(Tone::Warning)
    .right((StatusBar::text("12 items"),));
```

4176.name: key
4176.docs:
The node's identity among the motions of its view. Defaults to call
order, so use it for nodes built in a loop whose items come and go.

15729.name: DayMark
15729.docs: What marks a day of a [`YearView`].

23431.name: parents
23431.docs: Parent of each element, for hover-within.

16383.name: stretch
16383.docs: Stretches across the parent stack's cross axis.

20234.name: new
20234.docs: A scheduler over this stretch of time. Zooming and moving through time change `axis`.

17037.name: Floating
17037.docs: A rounded, raised panel away from the window's edges.

13840.name: size
13840.docs: Fixed size in logical pixels, instead of taking the free space.

14494.name: diagnostics_report_questions
14494.docs: The start of a new bug report: the questions for the person to answer.

18345.name: width

15148.name: filmstrip
15148.docs: A strip of thumbnails, as long as it needs to be.

23504.name: set_files_over
23504.docs: Says whether files are being dragged over the window (platform layers do this).

13259.name: label
13259.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

3668.name: UiActivity
3668.docs: What just happened in the UI, for something watching it as a whole.

18418.name: close_label
18418.docs: The close button's name for screen readers (from [`Labels`](crate::Labels) by default).

4322.name: AttachmentRow
4322.docs: One row of an [`AttachmentStrip`], with an identity of its own for its menu and button.

1779.name: UiWaker

10789.name: x_of
10789.docs: Where a column starts in the row.

14640.name: grid_reset
14640.docs: Puts a grid's sorting and filters back.

18491.name: range
18491.docs: The value range; also resets the step to 1/100 of the range.

1271.name: series_color
1271.docs: Adds a series in a color of your choosing.

2579.name: on_foreground
2579.docs: Runs `handler` when the foreground square is clicked, or on Enter and Space while focused.

3887.name: scrollbar_outside
3887.docs: How far past its edge the scrollbar goes.

23142.name: height
23142.docs: Scrolls inside this height, building only the lines in sight.

19945.name: x_of
19945.docs: Where a moment falls, in logical pixels from the start.

9700.name: matches_filter
9700.docs:
Does `value` (shown as `display`) pass a filter-row expression?

Numbers accept `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `=`, `<>` and ranges `a..b`; everything
else is a case-insensitive "contains". This is the short syntax of one cell; only
[`run_query`] knows the columns that a filter-row expression names.

20018.name: assign_lanes
20018.docs:
Places overlapping stretches of time on lanes, the earliest first, so none
overlaps another on its lane. Returns each one's lane, in the order given, and
how many lanes there are; at least one.

17475.name: action
17475.docs:
Adds a control at the end of the caption, usually a small [`IconButton`]
with a label, or a [`DropdownMenu`](crate::DropdownMenu). Hidden when
reduced to icons.

10427.name: empty_text
10427.docs: What it says when there is no data at all, as opposed to filters leaving nothing.

7230.name: visible
7230.docs:
Whether it is showing (it is by default). A hidden pane keeps its size for later,
and takes its bar with it.

182.name: loading
182.docs:
Shows an animated indicator over the content, which keeps its place so that the
button does not change width, and ignores clicks until it is done. It keeps
keyboard focus, and screen readers hear that it is loading and unavailable.

19437.name: Span
19437.docs: A run of text with one look.

14351.name: SortableList

255.name: label
255.docs: What the buttons are about, for screen readers.

22053.name: MOST_SHOWN
22053.docs: The options shown at a time; a search reaches the others.

22707.name: select_card
22707.docs: Picks `index`, as a click or Space does in this mode.

15659.name: padding
15659.docs: Room before the first row and after the last, in logical pixels.

5414.name: DockTabBar
5414.docs: When a group of a [`DockArea`] shows its tabs.

6068.name: ALL
6068.docs: All four, in the order they are searched.

20818.name: speak_clip
20818.docs:
Says a recording, in place of anything still being said, so that
[`SoundProvider::stop_speaking`] stops it. By default it only plays.

14424.name: culture
14424.docs: The language and region of numbers and dates in files, such as `pt-BR`.

18275.name: list_focus
18275.docs: The shared roving focus of a list that focuses row `start` when it opens.

15732.name: label
15732.docs: What screen readers say of the day.

8684.name: position
8684.docs:
Where in the window the toasts stack (the bottom-right corner by default). A toast
can ask for another place with [`ToastExtras::position`].

16386.name: tooltip
16386.docs: Shows `text` above the view while the pointer is over it; see [`Tooltip`].

20237.name: ranges
20237.docs: Shaded stretches of time across all rows.

17040.name: SidebarVariant
17040.docs: How a [`Sidebar`] sits next to the page.

13843.name: inertia
13843.docs: Lets a thrown drag coast (on by default).

18348.name: read_only
18348.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

11954.name: RuleOfThirdsGrid

23507.name: set_remote_waker
23507.docs:
Tells a platform when a [`UiWaker`](crate::UiWaker) fires, from whichever thread that is,
so it can leave its sleep. Only the first call counts.

6214.name: split_group
6214.docs: Opens a group of `id` on the edge of the group of `beside`.

13916.name: ChoiceOption
13916.docs:
Option of a single-choice group (radio buttons, segments): arrow keys select
and focus the neighbor, following the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern.

6868.name: DateTimePicker
6868.docs:
A [`DatePicker`] beside a [`TimePicker`], over one value. Picking a date first
sets the time to midnight, and clearing the time clears both.

21618.name: ShimmerText
21618.docs:
One line of text with a light passing over it, to say that something is under way.

When motion is reduced, or while [`active`](Self::active) is off, it is plain muted text
that asks for no frames.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::ShimmerText;

let waiting = ShimmerText::new("Looking for updates");
```

18421.name: close_button
18421.docs: Whether it shows the X in its corner (it does by default).

474.name: new
474.docs: `month` is shown when no date is selected yet.

15878.name: lookup
15878.docs: Choosing a record from a list too long to hold in memory.

1782.name: media
1782.docs: A photo, a document or a recording in the bubble, above the text, which may be empty.

6287.name: tidied
6287.docs:
Puts a node in its simplest form: panels seen once, no empty group, no split of one part or
inside another along the same axis, and shares that add up to one.

14643.name: grid_add_row
14643.docs: A data grid's button that adds a row.

18494.name: show_label
18494.docs: Also writes the [`label`](Self::label) before the value.

547.name: new
547.docs: `month` is shown when no period is chosen yet.

4398.name: transcript
4398.docs:
What was said, under a button that shows and hides it. Blank text says there is no
speech in the recording.

17259.name: full_width
17259.docs: The width the header and footer lay out at.

1274.name: format
1274.docs: How numbers appear on the axis (at most two decimals by default).

8976.name: form_rows
8976.docs:
Lays out `cells` in rows of `columns`: the index of the first cell of each
row, with how many it holds. A wide cell has a row of its own.

9630.name: display_summary
9630.docs: Formats an aggregate of this column.

13481.name: value_at
13481.docs:
What the curve through `points` gives for the input `x`, for applying it. It uses the
same curve the editor draws.

3236.name: along
3236.docs: Where the bar goes along one side of the content.

7741.name: on_files
7741.docs: Called with the files it took. It is not called when all of them were refused.

23145.name: expanded
23145.docs: The items open, by key, to keep or to set from outside.

19948.name: snap
19948.docs: The nearest moment an event can start or end at.

9703.name: search
9703.docs: Text searched in every visible column.

20602.name: placed_text
20602.docs: A text at a fixed place.

766.name: AnyView
766.docs: A type-erased view, for heterogeneous lists and dynamic UI.

2074.name: ORB_BOX
2074.docs: The room the sphere and its glow take, in logical pixels.

6579.name: edit_area
6579.docs: Applies a key to a text area. Returns false for keys it does not handle.

10430.name: name_column
10430.docs:
The column whose cell names a row for screen readers, in the buttons of
[`row_action`](Self::row_action). The key column, or else the first, by default.

185.name: shortcut
185.docs:
Shows a key cap after the label, in the label's color, such as `"F8"`. It only
shows the key: [`BuildCx::shortcut`] makes the key work.

20094.name: done
20094.docs: It already happened, so it stands back.

14354.name: moved_to
14354.docs: What is announced after a reorder. `{position}` and `{total}` are filled in.

9268.name: list_to_json
9268.docs: A list of scenarios as JSON, to keep in a file or a database.

24018.name: note
24018.docs: A short line under the title, such as what is missing.

18278.name: on_side
18278.docs: Set by a menubar: Left and Right open the neighbor menu.

4182.name: scroll_with_widget
4182.docs:
Makes the wheel over `node` move what this widget scrolls, for a part that
follows the scroll without being inside it, such as frozen row names.

985.name: indicator
985.docs: How each row shows its color.

20240.name: resource_width
20240.docs: The width of the resources column (200 by default).

20894.name: spacing
20894.docs: Gap between children, in logical pixels (default 16, `space-4`).

21548.name: RAIL_ICON_BUTTON
21548.docs: The side of a tool's button when the rail shows only icons.

8106.name: Node
8106.docs:
One line or group of the builder. What it cannot show as a line stays as `Raw`,
so opening someone's expression never loses any of it. `values` is what a list
comparison holds; the others use `value`.

1058.name: percent_text
1058.docs: A share of a whole, with no decimals to write in the reader's language.

6871.name: step_minutes
6871.docs: The minutes between the times in the list. 30 by default.

17770.name: expanded
17770.docs:
Keeps whether it is open in this binding, so the app decides and can remember it.
[`Self::open`] no longer matters.

21621.name: SHIMMER_FLOOR
21621.docs: Below this the light on a glyph would not show, so the glyph is not drawn twice.

477.name: fill
477.docs: Takes the width of its parent, as other fields of a form do.

4982.name: outline
4982.docs: Only the outline, without the tinted fill.

1785.name: card
1785.docs:
Something to act on under the text, such as buttons. It is built each time
the message is shown.

23583.name: reveal_offset
23583.docs:
Top-left corner of an overlay of `size`, kept inside the viewport.
The scroll offset along one axis that shows `target` inside `view`, moving
as little as possible. A target larger than the view shows its start.

6944.name: event_calendar
6944.docs: A month with what happens on each day, and the editor of how something repeats.

22348.name: theme
22348.docs: Adds a theme of the application's own to the menu, under its name.

4401.name: transcript_open
4401.docs:
Keeps whether the transcript is open in the app's hands. By default it starts closed
and is kept here.

15954.name: LookupResponder
15954.docs:
Delivers the answer to a [`LookupRequest`], now or later on the UI thread. An
answer to a search that was since replaced is ignored.

2512.name: cell_size
2512.docs: Sets the side of a square in logical pixels (10 by default).

22421.name: tiles
22421.docs: Things side by side: tiles to rearrange, and cards in as many columns as fit.

1277.name: alt
1277.docs:
Describes the chart for screen readers, in place of its title. Its values
are read after it.

13484.name: color
13484.docs: The color of the curve and its handles, as data, such as a channel's (ink by default).

3239.name: BarSurface
3239.docs: The bar itself. Its own view, so that the size it reports is the bar's.

3893.name: wheel_sideways
3893.docs: A wheel that only turns up and down moves this scroll container sideways.

7744.name: on_refused
7744.docs:
Called with one sentence for each refused file, in the words of [`crate::Labels`], for
showing them elsewhere. Without it they show inside the zone, under the content.

8398.name: Component

23148.name: on_open
23148.docs: Runs with the key on Enter or on a double click.

19951.name: Tick
19951.docs: A marked stretch of the axis, in pixels from its start.

2004.name: size
2004.docs:
Its size in logical pixels (400 by 520 by default). A smaller window gets
less height.

20024.name: AUTO_SCROLL_EDGE
20024.docs: A drag this close to an edge of the timeline scrolls it.

2077.name: ORB_EDGE
2077.docs: How far the sphere's box keeps from the edges of the window.

10433.name: row_detail
10433.docs:
Gives every row details of its own, opened by an arrow at its start or with the Right
key: a nested list, a form, a chart. The view is built only while it is open,
with the row and its index in the data.

842.name: WIDTHS_KEPT
842.docs:
Measured widths a chart keeps, more than even a long series has categories: one
forgotten while the same labels are still in use would be measured again each frame.

20097.name: SchedulerEvent
20097.docs: A bar on a [`Scheduler`]. One with no length shows as a milestone.

13049.name: label
13049.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

23948.name: step_state_text
23948.docs: The word for a state, for screen readers; the current step says so by being selected.

10506.name: SELECTED_ROW
10506.docs: How much accent a selected row shows, always more than either.

18208.name: element
18208.docs: Shown instead of the label, which still names the row.

6728.name: Time

4185.name: on_context_menu_in
4185.docs:
The same, also saying the element's absolute frame, for a menu that depends
on where inside the element it was opened.

988.name: label_format
988.docs: Writes the category on top in another way, such as a date in full.

23440.name: viewport_moved
23440.docs: A view that builds from its own size got a new one in the last layout.

20243.name: avatars
20243.docs: Shows the initials of each row's name beside it, for rows that are people.

14503.name: form_errors
14503.docs: Above the errors that keep a form from being saved.

19662.name: FOCUS_DIM
19662.docs: How much of its strength what is not in focus gives up.

23513.name: text_system
23513.docs: Fonts registered here become available to every `Text`.

20970.name: align
20970.docs:
Where the smaller layers go, along both axes. `Stretch`, the default, gives them the
whole width and puts them at the top.

17773.name: new
17773.docs: A collapsed disclosure with this title and content.

14576.name: compare_first
14576.docs: The caption over the first picture of a [`CompareView`](crate::CompareView).

480.name: read_only
480.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

1134.name: horizontal
1134.docs: Bars lie down, with their categories on the left.

23586.name: hash_text
23586.docs: A stable number for a text key, for [`BuildCx::keyed_child`].

553.name: label
553.docs: The name screen readers announce. Inside a [`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

1861.name: Send
1861.docs: Adds what was written to the messages and passes it on.

17919.name: KeyBubble
17919.docs: The bubble of a tooltip that also shows a key.

22424.name: new
22424.docs: A tile known by `key`, under this title.

1280.name: stack
1280.docs: How series share a category: side by side by default, or stacked.

20535.name: tab_stop
20535.docs: The event keyboard users reach with Tab.

13487.name: histogram
13487.docs: Shows these channels behind the curve, as a [`Histogram`] does, faintly.

3896.name: PickedFile
3896.docs: A file brought into the app, whole, in memory.

7747.name: most_files
7747.docs: The most files taken from one drop. No limit by default.

22497.name: reconcile
22497.docs:
Spots in the order of the tiles, for tiles a saved layout has not heard of yet,
dropping what is no longer there.

8401.name: icon
8401.docs: Shows an icon in the accent color above the name.

2007.name: minimized
2007.docs: Adds a button that reduces it to its header and brings it back, kept in `minimized`.

16757.name: active
16757.docs: The latest paint found something still moving.

23878.name: on_cancel
23878.docs: Shows a Cancel button that runs this.

20681.name: group
20681.docs: Adds a group of `(keys, what they do)`.

10436.name: on_export_file
10436.docs:
Shows an Export menu with Excel, PDF and CSV; `handler` receives the format and the rows
that match, as shown. `ravenrs-grid-export` turns these into a file.

14287.name: HelpTip
14287.docs:
A small "?" beside something that needs explaining. Its panel opens under the
pointer and on keyboard focus, and a click keeps it open until a click elsewhere.
Screen readers get the same words as the button's description.

15595.name: anchored
15595.docs: Where the anchor has gone. A row that left the list leaves the offset alone.

16249.name: remove
16249.docs: Removes a model from the machine.

14360.name: dock_left
14360.docs: The left dock of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea), in a menu.

18211.name: open_submenu
18211.docs:
The row of this list whose submenu is open, set when any row of the list has one.
The flag says the submenu takes the keyboard, as it does unless the pointer opened it.

4115.name: FilePicker
4115.docs: A shared handle to the file chooser, from [`crate::BuildCx::file_picker`].

4188.name: request_focus_node
4188.docs:
Moves keyboard focus to the widget that built `node` (a child's trigger
button, say) after the build.

991.name: icons
991.docs: Shows the icons of the series in place of their colors.

9347.name: capture
9347.docs: The layout of a grid as it stands.

20246.name: lane_menu
20246.docs: What a right click on an empty stretch offers, given the row and the time there.

17703.name: new
17703.docs: A breadcrumb of `items`, from the root to the current page.

21554.name: new
21554.docs: A rail of these tools; `selected` says which one is open.

7458.name: show_errors
7458.docs: Shows errors even for empty values (e.g. after a submit attempt).

4261.name: size
4261.docs: Its size in bytes, which is shown in the units people read.

4915.name: timeline
4915.docs: A bar per recent frame, split by where its time went.

19665.name: SPOKEN_FLOWS
19665.docs: How many flows a screen reader hears, and a tooltip shows, before the rest is left out.

10074.name: culture
10074.docs: The language and region of numbers and dates, such as `pt-BR`.

17776.name: mark
17776.docs:
Shows this view at the end of the header, so what is inside can be told while it
is closed. A [`Dot`](crate::Dot) with a label says it to screen readers as well.

21627.name: new
21627.docs: A neutral dot, 8 logical pixels across.

14579.name: lightbox_previous
14579.docs: Goes to the previous picture of an [`ImageLightbox`](crate::ImageLightbox).

483.name: label
483.docs:
The name screen readers announce, such as "Due date". Inside a
[`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

1137.name: ChartBarFrom
1137.docs: Where the bars of a [`Chart`] grow from.

12036.name: BAND_MIN_DRAG
12036.docs: Below this many pixels, a press and release is a click and not a selection.

3099.name: entry_node
3099.docs: The element of one entry of a bar of commands.

6950.name: new
6950.docs:
`month` holds the month shown (any day of it), so the app can load its
events; `selected` holds the day picked.

3753.name: shift
3753.docs: It also needs Shift; without this, Shift does not matter.

14652.name: grid_filter_column
14652.docs: Before a column's name, in its filter's name.

5061.name: inherit_color
5061.docs:
Takes its color from what it is in ([`BuildCx::with_foreground`]) and drops its own
fill, so that on a filled button the key reads as part of the button instead of a
gray box. [`Button::shortcut`] and [`Tooltip::shortcut`](crate::Tooltip::shortcut)
do this. With no color around it, it uses its usual one.

8912.name: form_layout
8912.docs: Arranging the fields of a form: groups, columns, tabs and what is wrong.

12763.name: Protractor

10220.name: generation
10220.docs: Bumped when the query changes, so that an old answer is not taken for a new one.

21119.name: new
21119.docs: A spacer with no minimum size.

19230.name: BODY_HEIGHT
19230.docs: Large button height area (icon + two lines of label).

1283.name: bars_from
1283.docs: Where bars grow from: up from the bottom by default.

20538.name: selection
20538.docs: Row by row, for Up and Down.

3899.name: semantics
3899.docs: How the element appears to assistive technology.

7750.name: hint
7750.docs:
What shows over the content while files are over the window. By default,
[`file_drop`](crate::Labels::file_drop) of the labels.

8404.name: reveal_after
8404.docs:
Holds the name back this many seconds, and what is under it a little longer,
for an animated [`Self::logo`] to play alone. Their places are kept, so nothing
moves when they appear, and screen readers have them from the start. Where
motion is reduced they show at once.

2010.name: header_height
2010.docs: The height of the header alone, the height of a reduced panel.

23808.name: build_each
23808.docs: Builds each child in order and appends its node to `out`.

9712.name: toggle_group
9712.docs: Adds the column to or removes it from the grouping; expands all groups.

11674.name: Fill
11674.docs: Stretches to the frame, ignoring the aspect ratio.

22573.name: TileHandle
22573.docs: The grip of a tile. Focus and drags go by view, so it is one.

2083.name: OrbColors
2083.docs: The theme's colors, for painting the sphere.

12982.name: label
12982.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

10439.name: group_panel
10439.docs:
Shows or hides the space where columns are dropped to group by them. It shows
along with the toolbar, unless this says otherwise.

16252.name: downloaded
16252.docs: Marks a model that is on this machine.

23954.name: size
23954.docs: Its diameter in logical pixels (24 by default).

13709.name: ZoomDrawFn
13709.docs: Draws content from where a view puts it.

10512.name: open
10512.docs: The rows with details open, in order.

14363.name: dock_center
14363.docs: The center of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea), in a menu.

18214.name: pointer_in
18214.docs: Told when the pointer is over this list, if it is itself a submenu.

22065.name: placeholder
22065.docs: Text shown while nothing is chosen.

4118.name: MotionEntry
4118.docs: One [`BuildCx::motion`] call of the latest build.

11820.name: placement
11820.docs: The destination rectangle and source UVs for drawing `aspect` into `frame`.

20176.name: SchedulerChange
20176.docs: An event moved, resized, or drawn for the first time: where it would now be.

13128.name: Histogram

4191.name: wheel_scrolls_sideways
4191.docs:
Makes a wheel that only turns up and down move this scroll container sideways,
for a strip with nothing to scroll in the other direction.

994.name: no_indicator_for
994.docs:
The row of this series has no square or bar, for a value that is not one of
those the chart tells apart, such as a target.

1648.name: MESSAGE_WIDTH
1648.docs: The widest a message gets, in logical pixels.

23446.name: scrolled_at
23446.docs: When each scroll container last moved: its scrollbar shows only around that.

9350.name: Empty
9350.docs: No value; shown as an empty cell.

20249.name: on_change
20249.docs: An event was moved or resized.

10004.name: prefix
10004.docs: Text before it, such as a currency sign.

21557.name: width
21557.docs: Its width, in logical pixels (76 by default, or what the columns take).

7461.name: error_text
7461.docs: What is wrong, as something else found out, such as rules that read a database.

4264.name: thumbnail
4264.docs: A small picture in place of the icon.

23519.name: set_reduced_motion
23519.docs:
Tells the runtime that the system asks for reduced motion. Things stop
traveling and springing; colors and opacity may still fade. A theme can
ask for the same through its `reduced_motion` token.

10077.name: group_by
10077.docs: The column rows are grouped by, by its index in [`columns`](Self::columns).

17779.name: key
17779.docs:
What tells this disclosure apart inside an [`Accordion`], so it keeps its state
when the list changes (its position by default).

21630.name: size
21630.docs: Sets the diameter in logical pixels.

13347.name: hue
13347.docs: Degrees, from 0 up to 360. Red is 0.

6953.name: events_per_day
6953.docs: How many events show in a day before the rest become a count (3 by default).

8915.name: MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH
8915.docs: A field narrower than this moves to a line of its own, wherever the form is.

12766.name: step
12766.docs: The smallest change, in degrees (0.1 by default).

15382.name: Extents
15382.docs: How long each piece is along the strip, written by the pieces as they are laid out.

1286.name: bar_radius

21195.name: EDGE_ARROW_LEAST_STEP
21195.docs: The least an arrow of a [`ScrollEdgeArrow`] scrolls, in logical pixels.

3902.name: motion
3902.docs: Index of this element's entry among the build's motions.

7753.name: padding
7753.docs: The space around the content, in logical pixels (`space-4` by default).

16763.name: Ui
16763.docs:
The platform-independent UI runtime: owns the root view, reacts to input and
state changes, and produces a [`Scene`] for the renderer.

Platform layers drive it with [`Ui::set_viewport`], [`Ui::handle_event`] and
[`Ui::update`], and register a waker with [`Ui::set_waker`] to schedule a
frame when state changes outside of event handling (timers, async tasks).

21268.name: new
21268.docs: A grid of `columns` equal columns (at least 1).

778.name: KeptPicture
778.docs: A picture that is not on screen anymore.

4629.name: date
4629.docs:
A small civil-date type for calendars and date pickers (proleptic Gregorian,
no time zones), so date components need no external dependency.

9788.name: totals
9788.docs: Aggregates per column over all matching rows.

10442.name: scenarios
10442.docs:
Offers saving its arrangement under a name and coming back to it. Keep the list
with [`GridScenario::list_to_json`].

3394.name: keyed_child
3394.docs:
Builds a child with an explicit key, so it keeps its hover/focus state
when siblings are inserted or removed (use it for dynamic lists).

14293.name: listen
14293.docs: A [`Chat`](crate::Chat)'s button to hear an answer.

851.name: separator

4702.name: diagnostics
4702.docs: A panel any desktop app can open to see its GPU and what its frames cost.

The sizes the parts of a split get in `room`: their shares, with each part at least at its
smallest and the difference taken from those that have some to spare.

13712.name: target

10515.name: row_at
10515.docs: The row covering this height, or the one its details belong to.

14366.name: dock_split_right
14366.docs: Opens a group to the right of a panel's own in a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea).

18217.name: follow_pointer

22068.name: fill

11823.name: Fit
11823.docs: Content of this size, shown whole and centered in the box, as an image that fits.

17636.name: SidebarSubmenu

11242.name: WaitingRow

Moves the node's children by `offset` when painting (e.g. a header that
follows a body's horizontal scroll).

Glides the node from its old frame to its new one when layout moves it.

20252.name: on_delete

7464.name: note_text

4921.name: BADGE_TEXT_TOWARD_INK
4921.docs: How far a badge's text goes from its tone toward the ink.

23522.name: cursor
23522.docs: The cursor the platform should show.

20325.name: open_menu
20325.docs: Opens a menu of these items at this place, until something closes it.

14585.name: recurrence_units
14585.docs: The singular and plural of day, week, month and year.

7537.name: multiple

8845.name: new
8845.docs: A combobox over `options`; `selected` holds the zero-based index of the choice, or `None`.

13350.name: HueSaturation
13350.docs: A color as a [`ColorWheel`] holds it, without brightness.

10153.name: rows
10153.docs: The rows, at most as many as were asked for.

3105.name: separator
3105.docs: Appends a line between groups of commands.

14658.name: rating
14658.docs: What a [`Rating`](crate::Rating) is called when nothing says what is rated.

12769.name: disabled
12769.docs: Shows the angle without letting it change.

6375.name: new
6375.docs: Nothing anywhere yet, with the docks at their usual sizes.

21779.name: new

15385.name: key_target
15385.docs: Where a key moves a piece: Alt with an arrow one place, and Alt with Home or End to the ends.

1289.name: negative_color
1289.docs: The color of bars below zero.

12188.docs:
Where an eyedropper picks from, over a picture. While armed, a click asks `sampler` for the
color at that point of the content, in the units of the [space](Self::space); a point out of
the content or a `None` picks nothing and leaves it armed. While not armed it takes no input.

5140.name: tone
5140.docs: Sets the fill color tone (accent by default).

12842.name: size
12842.docs: Fixed size in logical pixels, instead of taking the free space.

6448.name: line
6448.docs: The line of the problem, from one.

7756.name: disabled
7756.docs: Turns it off: it takes no files and does not react to them.

18655.name: Weekly
18655.docs: Every `interval` weeks, on the chosen weekdays.

22506.name: columns
22506.docs: The most columns, when there is room. 4 by default.

16766.name: sync
16766.docs:
Records the targets of a build. `snap` lands colors at once (the theme
changed, and the whole picture crossfades instead).

5940.name: value
5940.docs: The size it controls now, and the limits of that size.

16839.name: new
16839.docs: Shows `content` at full height while `open` is true, and nothing otherwise.

2743.name: clipboard
2743.docs: The clipboard widgets copy to and paste from.

13642.name: placed
13642.docs:
Where the whole content lands on screen. Much of it may be outside `frame`: draw only
what touches `frame` when there is a lot to draw.

10445.name: selected_keys
10445.docs:
Where the keys of the selected rows live, with
[`key_column`](Self::key_column). Unlike row indices, keys still mean the same
records after the data is replaced.

21344.name: FooterArea
21344.docs: One area of a [`Footer`]. It exists even when empty, to hold its grid column.

14296.name: TagBox

11753.docs:
When the image changes, dissolves from the old one to the new one over this many
seconds. It asks for frames only while that lasts, and with reduced motion the new
one simply appears. Pass a clone of the same [`ImageData`] while the picture is the
same: new data counts as a new image, even with the same pixels.

4705.name: TIMELINE_HEIGHT
4705.docs: The height of the picture of the latest frames.

8556.name: travel
8556.docs: Where a toast comes from and goes to: the edge it is nearest to.

12407.name: confined
12407.docs:
Like [`Self::apply`], as far as it goes while inside `bounds`. Without a ratio each axis
stops on its own, so a handle slides along an edge it reached.

6013.name: shown_name
6013.docs: The name of a pair: what shows on either side of a bar.

13715.name: Glide
13715.docs:
What a throw of the content does after the pointer lets go: the path of a critically
damped spring that ends where friction would, or at the limit if that comes first.

21417.name: center_tone
21417.docs: Tints the middle, and only the middle, to make a notice stand out.

14369.name: dock_reopen
14369.docs: The item of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea)'s menu that lists closed panels.

22071.name: disabled
22071.docs: Turns the field off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

4124.name: foreground
4124.docs: The text color of the view being built, for content that takes it from what it is in.

14442.name: theme_accent

4197.name: scrollbar_outside
4197.docs: Puts this scroll container's scrollbar `by` past its right edge, in the room around it.

23452.name: wake
23452.docs: Earliest time a widget asked to be rebuilt at.

16404.name: shape_only

With [`Self::layout`], moves only the node's own shape. Its children stay
where layout put them.

20255.name: lane_height
20255.docs: Groups stay together, in the order their first resource appears.

2308.name: Pagination

6159.name: Tab

Into the group of `beside`, in the gap `at`: 0 is before its first tab, and anything past
the end is after its last.

2381.name: new
2381.docs: A heart bound to `value`; clicking flips it.

3035.name: Toolbar

14588.name: recurrence_ends
14588.docs: Never, on a date and after a number of times, as an editor offers them.

8848.name: width

2454.name: Left

13353.name: offset
13353.docs:
Where this color sits, relative to the center of a wheel of this radius: red to the
right and hue growing counterclockwise, as color tools lay it out.

10156.name: totals
10156.docs: Aggregates per column, for the footer.

3108.name: aligned_end
3108.docs: Takes the room left in its row, with the commands at the far end.

21709.name: read_only
21709.docs:
Stars that only show `value`. They cost one element, however many are drawn, so
they can go in every cell of a long list.

14661.name: yesterday
14661.docs: A [`DaySeparator`](crate::DaySeparator) for the day before today.

6378.name: right
6378.docs: Puts this in the right dock, `size` logical pixels wide.

21782.name: size
21782.docs: Sets the side of the square in logical pixels. The icon follows it.

15388.name: marker
15388.docs:
The line that marks the target, for a piece to carry at its start or at its end. It stays
out of the flow, so showing it moves nothing.

1292.name: dot_icon
1292.docs: Draws this icon on each point of a line, in place of a dot.

12191.name: new
12191.docs: Not armed, with no color yet.

5143.name: label
5143.docs: What is progressing, above the bar. It also names it for screen readers.

12845.name: aspect
12845.docs:
Holds this width over height, or lets it go free with `None`. A crop of other proportions
is cut down to these as soon as this changes.

6451.name: Syntax
6451.docs: It is not well-formed text in the format.

10302.name: chunk_size
10302.docs: How many rows to ask for at a time.

21855.name: HeroBanner

18658.name: ALL
18658.docs: Every frequency, in the order an editor offers them.

22509.name: locked
22509.docs: Keeps tiles where they are, with no handles.

16769.name: sample
16769.docs: The node's values at this frame. `shift` is what scrolling added to its frame.

7178.name: SPLIT_BAR
7178.docs: How wide the bar between panes is, grip and room around it, in logical pixels.

21928.name: new
21928.docs: `text` with the light passing over it.

4635.name: day
4635.docs: The day of the month, starting at 1.

1438.name: new
1438.docs: A chart of `(label, value)` bars; negative values are clamped to 0.

20039.name: TODAY_TINT
20039.docs: How much of today's column is tinted.

2746.name: read
2746.docs: The clipboard's text, if it can be read now.

13645.name: custom
13645.docs: A map showing what `draw` draws, for content of this size in units of the caller.

6597.name: on_leave
6597.docs: Called when the keyboard goes elsewhere after being here.

10448.name: on_add_row
10448.docs: Shows an Add button in the toolbar. The handler adds the row, or opens a form to.

11102.name: ValueFilterHandle
11102.docs: What a checkbox of a [`ValueFilter`] keeps to write the filter.

11756.name: content_mode
11756.docs: How the image fills its frame (`Cover` by default).

4708.name: VIEWS_SHOWN
4708.docs: How many views the panel lists.

23309.name: SCROLLBAR_HOLD
23309.docs: How long a scrollbar stays after the last scroll, and how long it takes to go.

9213.name: Summary
9213.docs: An aggregate shown in group rows and in the footer.

6016.name: DockChild
6016.docs: A part of a split and how much of it it takes.

17569.name: selected
17569.docs: Highlights the item as the current location.

21420.name: text
21420.docs: Text in a status bar's usual look: small and muted.

4127.name: with_foreground
4127.docs:
Builds what `build` builds with `color` as its [`Self::foreground`]. Layers opened
inside it start without one, since they are not painted over this view.

11829.name: ContentSpace
11829.docs:
How the coordinates of a widget drawn over content relate to the screen, so that a selection
or a crop is told in the units of the content whatever the zoom.

16988.name: SEGMENT_TRACK_PADDING
16988.docs: What separates the track of segmented tabs from the piece inside it.

14445.name: theme_sizes
14445.docs: A theme editor's group: the sizes of text.

4200.name: floating_overlay
4200.docs:
Builds `view` as a layer that stays open beside the UI, like a chat in a
corner: it is under every menu and dialog, wherever it is built, keeps its state
when they open, and is not closed by a click outside it.

1657.name: photo
1657.docs:
A photo. While it is `None` it holds a space of the same size, so that what is above
does not jump when it arrives.

16407.name: exit
16407.docs:
When the node stops being built, its last picture stays on screen and
plays this effect. The picture takes no input and is hidden from
assistive technology: for the app, the node is already gone. Reopening
during the exit reverses it from where it is.

9359.name: as_f64
9359.docs: The numeric value: numbers as is, booleans as 0.0 or 1.0, otherwise `None`.

2311.name: labels
2311.docs:
The text of the two buttons and the word screen readers say before a
page number, for apps in other languages.

6162.name: Split
6162.docs: A group of its own, opened on one side of the group of `beside`.

3619.name: position
3619.docs: Pointer position in absolute logical pixels.

22220.name: secure
22220.docs: Shows dots instead of the characters (passwords).

23528.name: modal_root
23528.docs:
The topmost full-window layer (dialog, sheet, command palette): while it
is open, focus stays inside it.

2384.name: size
2384.docs: Sets the size of the mark in logical pixels (16 by default). The target around it follows.

14591.name: recurrence_next
14591.docs: Before the next days, in words.

19096.name: RibbonItem
19096.docs: A command in a ribbon group: a button, a toggle, or a button with a menu.

8851.name: read_only
8851.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

9505.name: CellAlign
9505.docs: Horizontal alignment of a column's cells.

20404.name: scroll
20404.docs: How far the timeline has scrolled, as of the last build.

10159.name: total

in the panel instead of reaching what is underneath.

21712.name: tone

14664.name: favorite
14664.docs: What a [`FavoriteToggle`](crate::FavoriteToggle) is called when nothing says what it marks.

7616.name: save
7616.docs: Hands a file over to the person.

15391.name: pick
15391.docs:
Applies a pick of `index` to a selection: alone by default, toggled with Ctrl or Cmd, and
from `anchor` to it with Shift. Returns the new anchor. `key` says what the selection keeps
for each position, which may be the position itself.

1295.name: tick_format
1295.docs: How categories are written on the axis, such as a month's first letters.

12194.name: is_armed
12194.docs: Whether the next click on the picture picks a color.

12848.name: turning_guide
12848.docs: The lines inside the frame while it turns (eight parts by default).

6454.name: UnsupportedVersion
6454.docs: It was saved by a newer build, in a version this one cannot read.

10305.name: peak_rows
10305.docs: The most rows it has held at any moment.

21204.name: spacing
21204.docs: Gap between children, in logical pixels (default 8).

10959.name: DRAG_FROM
10959.docs: What the pointer has to travel before a press becomes a drag, and not a click.

16772.name: crossfade
16772.docs: Fades out a whole picture: what the screen showed before a theme change.

4638.name: add_months
4638.docs: Moves by whole months, clamping the day (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29).

10451.name: group_by
10451.docs: Initial grouping; call again for nested groups.

7254.name: split_sizes
7254.docs:
The sizes the visible panes get in `room`: what they ask for within their limits, with
the free room going to those that do not ask, and any lack taken from the last ones.

18807.name: weekday
18807.docs: For weekly rules, the next weekday to look at in this week.

22658.name: move_to_cell
22658.docs: Moves a tile to the place in the order that puts it at this cell.

23312.name: MAX_FRAME_GAP
23312.docs: Longest time between frames that animations treat as having really passed.

5365.name: TOGGLE
5365.docs: How thick the strip that collapses a dock is.

9216.name: columns

17572.name: badge

tone or a word such as "New".

The views in the middle, which get the width the sides leave. Give the
text `.truncate().grow(1.0)` so that it is what gets cut.

14375.name: dock_resize_pair
14375.docs: The bar between two parts of a split, with `{first}` and `{second}`.

4130.name: theme
4130.docs: The theme in effect for this build.

11832.name: scale
11832.docs: Logical pixels on screen per unit of content.

Changes without reactive state: builds move it along, and must not ask for
another build by doing so. `test_runs` is what tells the UI about a new one.

16337.name: Styled
16337.docs: A view wrapped in a box with layout and background modifiers; see [`ViewExt`].

16991.name: SIDEBAR_RAIL_STRIP
16991.docs: How wide the strip of a [`Sidebar::rail`] is.

13794.name: release
13794.docs: Starts coasting at the speed of the last frames, or stops.

3549.name: Live

19607.name: strike_on
19607.docs: The strike goes on over the space after it.

1660.name: AudioPlayerButton

9362.name: key_text
9362.docs:
The text that identifies a row by this value, in
[`DataGrid::key_column`](crate::DataGrid::key_column).

13213.name: HistogramPicture
13213.docs: What it takes to draw a set of channels, apart from any widget.

6165.docs:
Sends a panel somewhere: into a group, beside it, or into a place; a closed one reopens
there. It says whether anything changed, which it does not if the target is gone, or the
panel is already what it would become.

3622.name: Drag
3622.docs: A pointer drag on an element, in absolute logical pixels, with the element's frame.

22223.name: compact
22223.docs:
A shorter field with smaller text, for toolbars, filter rows and cells: the same
as [`Self::size`] with [`ButtonSize::Small`].

8781.name: new
8781.docs: A palette shown while `open` is true; Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles it.

23531.name: first_focusable
23531.docs: The first focusable element under `root`, in tree order.

since the id of a panel is what stays the same as the tree changes around it.

3041.name: disabled
3041.docs:
Greys the command out. It keeps its place, so its neighbors do not move
under the pointer, but it is left out of the overflow menu.

14594.name: grid_remove_group
14594.docs: Stops grouping a grid by a column.

19099.name: large

20407.name: view_width
20407.docs: How wide the timeline in view is, as of the last build.

2460.name: NinePointAnchor

14013.name: pop_mark
14013.docs: The check or dot inside a selected control pops in and fades away.

21715.name: clearable
21715.docs: Clicking the current score takes it away.

14667.name: anchor_names

13432.name: CURVE_REACH

14086.name: range

18591.name: new

15394.name: sortable

1298.name: grid_columns

Upright gridlines evenly spread into this many columns, instead of one at each
category or number.

12197.name: listen_for_escape

1952.name: nearest

14159.name: disabled

21861.name: action

14813.name: on_reorder
14813.docs: Called with where a tab was and where it should go, and lets them be moved.

4568.name: Table

15467.name: LINE_STEP

12270.name: new

5222.name: message

2679.name: AspectRatio
2679.docs: Keeps its content at a width-to-height ratio while filling the width.

6530.name: DEFAULT_ROWS

until it is answered; show [`ConfirmDialog`] once, and call
[`ask`](Self::ask) from anywhere.

15540.name: view

5295.name: large

6603.name: grouping

10454.name: toolbar

14305.name: candle_open

11762.name: alt

as decoration and hidden from them.

4714.name: BugReporter

23315.name: PAINT_MARGIN

How far past a clip a node still gets painted: what it draws around itself, such as
a shadow, can reach into the clip.

16921.name: item

Adds a tab with this label and no content, for an app that shows what goes with
it elsewhere.

2825.name: parse_hex

17575.name: on_click

4133.name: labels

11835.name: rect_to_screen

16340.name: background

the focus between buttons; Space or Enter toggles the focused one.

16994.name: Icons
16994.docs: It narrows to a rail of icons, with the labels as tooltips.

14451.name: theme_contrast
14451.docs: A contrast, and the token it is measured over.

8057.name: takes_list

1663.name: size

5514.name: key_of

13216.name: column

24443.name: ravenrs_widgets
24443.docs:
Declarative views and the UI runtime.

# Writing components

There are three ways to make your own component, from simplest to most powerful:

1. **A function** returning `impl View`, composing existing views. Good for
   stateless pieces of UI.
2. **A [`Component`]**: a struct holding its state ([`State`](ravenrs_reactive::State)
   fields, bindings, callbacks) with a `body()` that composes views. This is the
   SwiftUI-style building block and covers most needs.
3. **A [`View`]** implemented directly: full control over layout boxes,
   painting (including arbitrary [`Scene`](ravenrs_core::Scene) drawing through
   [`Paint::Custom`]), hit-testing, focus and click handling via [`BuildCx`].
   The built-in widgets are written this way, with no private API.

[`Canvas`] is the shortcut for custom drawing inside a normal layout.

# Features

* `decode` (default): PNG and JPEG decoding for [`Image::from_bytes`].
* `charts` (default): `Chart`, `BarChart`, `AreaChart` and `Barcode`. They draw
  the same charts and codes as reports, through `ravenrs-graphics`.

# Runtime

[`Ui`] owns the root view and turns it into a [`Scene`](ravenrs_core::Scene):
*build* (views to elements, tracked by a reactive observer), *layout* (Taffy),
*paint*. It only rebuilds when state the last build read has changed or the
interaction state (hover, press, focus) changed, and it never touches the GPU.

# Motion

A view declares how a node moves with [`BuildCx::motion`] and the runtime
plays it. While only animations run, frames repeat the paint phase alone, so
views are not rebuilt. When nothing moves, no frames are requested.

2006.docs:
Lets it go anywhere in the window, dragged by its header or moved with the arrow
keys on it, without the sphere: `open` is what opens it. `place` holds its top-left
corner, so the app can remember it, and is written when a drag ends; `None` puts it
in the corner at the bottom right. It stays inside a window that gets smaller.

771.name: PICTURES_KEPT_BYTES
771.docs:
Bytes of pictures kept after their chart is gone: about ten charts filling a laptop's
screen at 2x.

2079.name: ORB_REST
2079.docs: The moment of its motion it holds when still.

12978.name: captions
12978.docs:
What the small captions over the pictures say, instead of those in
[`Labels`](crate::Labels).

23877.name: on_finish
23877.docs: Runs after the last step's check passes.

20680.name: title
20680.docs: Sets the title, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

10435.name: expanded_rows
10435.docs: The rows with details open, by index in the data, to keep or to set from outside.

14286.name: close
14286.docs: Closes a dialog or a sheet.

11743.name: decode_image
11743.docs: Decodes PNG or JPEG bytes into RGBA pixels.

10508.name: DETAIL_ARROW_WIDTH
10508.docs: Room for the arrow that opens a row's details, and for a row's check box.

14359.name: dock_empty
14359.docs: What a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea) says with nothing in its center.

18210.name: submenu
18210.docs: What this row opens at its side.

20172.name: id
20172.docs: The event; for one being created, `None`.

14432.name: no_results
14432.docs: A combobox's search that found nothing.

4187.name: request_focus
4187.docs:
Moves keyboard focus to this widget's focusable element after the build,
scrolling the containers around it until it shows.

990.name: show_total
990.docs: Adds a last row with the sum of the series, under this name.

1644.name: whole_modules
1644.docs: The largest box that fits in `room` and holds whole pixels per module.

20245.name: event_menu
20245.docs: What a right click on a bar offers, by the event's id.

17702.name: Breadcrumb

17775.name: title_view
17775.docs:
Shows this view in the header instead of the title, which still names it for
screen readers.

21626.name: label
21626.docs: What the dot means, for screen readers.

14578.name: lightbox
14578.docs: An [`ImageLightbox`](crate::ImageLightbox)'s name, for a picture with no caption.

482.name: FormField

1136.name: Right
1136.docs: To the left from the right, with their categories beside them.

3098.name: register_hotkeys
3098.docs: Makes the keys of these commands work for as long as they are built.

18502.name: TextField

555.name: read_only
555.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

12108.name: kept_inside
12108.docs: `rect` moved to be inside `bounds`, and no larger than them.

5060.name: shortcut
5060.docs: Shows this key as a key cap beside the text, such as `"⌘S"`.

21118.name: Spacer
21118.docs: Flexible empty space that pushes its siblings apart inside a stack.

1282.name: fill_opacity
1282.docs: How solid an area or a radar polygon is, from 0 to 1.

13489.name: disabled
13489.docs: Turns the control off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

10292.name: evict
10292.docs: Drops the chunks used longest ago, never one on the screen.

8403.name: status
8403.docs: Sets the one-line message under the name. Screen readers announce each new one.

16759.name: enabled
16759.docs:
A platform drives the clock. Without one nothing could ever finish, so
everything lands at once; this is also what makes headless tests stable.

9711.name: toggle_sort
9711.docs:
Plain click: sort by this column only, cycling ascending → descending →
none. With `add`, the column is added to (or cycled within) a multi-column sort.

11673.name: Fit
11673.docs: Shows the whole image, letterboxed inside the frame (`contain`).

20029.name: PINCH_STEP
20029.docs: How far a pinch goes before it zooms one step.

12981.name: grow
12981.docs: How much of the free space along the parent stack it takes (1 by default).

10438.name: page_size
10438.docs: Shows the rows a page at a time, with a pager at the bottom.

21991.name: of
21991.docs:
A separator for `day`: the words for today and yesterday from
[`Labels`](crate::Labels), and otherwise the short date.

847.name: at
847.docs: The category, between two of them while it glides from one to the other.

8549.name: TopCenter
8549.docs: The middle of the top edge.

20102.name: resizable
20102.docs: Whether its length can change (on by default). It can still be moved.

14362.name: dock_bottom
14362.docs: The bottom dock of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea), in a menu.

18213.name: SubmenuAim
18213.docs:
What lets the pointer go diagonally to a submenu: crossing the rows between would
otherwise close it. A move that is mostly sideways gets a moment; the row it is over
takes over when that ends, unless the pointer has reached the submenu.

22064.name: new
22064.docs: A field bound to the keys chosen, in the order they were chosen.

11819.name: push_image
11819.docs: Draws `data` into `frame` the way an [`Image`] does.

13127.name: Logarithmic
13127.docs:
Height follows the logarithm of the count, which brings small hills into view next
to a tall peak.

4190.name: scrollable_virtual
4190.docs:
A scroll container in both directions whose content is rebuilt on every
scroll (see [`Self::scroll_viewport`]).

993.name: value_color
993.docs:
Colors a value by what it says, such as a loss in red. It is given the index
of the series and the value; `None` leaves it in the color of the text.

22791.name: new
22791.docs: A track named `label`, `height` logical pixels tall.

9349.name: grid
9349.docs:
An enterprise-style data grid: [`DataGrid`] over [`GridData`] with
[`GridColumn`]s. The query pipeline in [`query`] is pure and usable on its own.

20248.name: toolbar
20248.docs: The buttons to move through time and zoom (on by default).

20902.name: wrap
20902.docs:
Moves children that do not fit onto new lines (rows wrap down,
columns wrap right).

21556.name: separator
21556.docs: Adds a line between two groups of tools.

7460.name: required
7460.docs: Marks the label with `*` and adds the [`validate::required`] rule (for the value set by [`FormField::validate`]).

4263.name: icon
4263.docs: The icon before its name ([`IconName::File`] by default).

19667.name: Item
19667.docs: A node or a flow of the diagram, as one list: the nodes first.

23518.name: set_time
23518.docs:
Sets the clock (seconds since the app started). Platforms call it before
handling events and before each frame. Animations start only once a
platform drives this clock.

Animations follow their own clock, which skips stalls: after a long pause
(a hidden window, a slow frame) they continue about where they were
instead of jumping to the end.

20321.name: FollowOn
20321.docs: Goes on with a drag, given where the pointer now is in the timeline's content.

21629.name: color
21629.docs: Uses this color instead of the tone's.

14581.name: lightbox_counter
14581.docs: Which picture of how many an [`ImageLightbox`](crate::ImageLightbox) is showing.

12038.name: pressed
12038.docs: Where the drag began, in units of the content.

6952.name: today
6952.docs: Marks this day, and offers a button to come back to it.

3755.name: Shortcut

12111.name: MARQUEE_SPEED
12111.docs: How fast the dashes walk, in pixels per second.

12765.name: range
12765.docs: The least and the most it reaches, in degrees.

10222.name: end
10222.docs: One past the last row known to exist.

22429.name: new
22429.docs: A tile taking this many cells.

1285.name: labels_at_zero
1285.docs:
The categories of bars sit on the line of zero, on its other side from the bar,
instead of along the edge of the chart: for values both ways from zero.

21194.name: EDGE_ARROW_LENGTH
21194.docs: How long the fade of a [`ScrollEdgeArrow`] is, in logical pixels.

3901.name: text
3901.docs: The string a text leaf shows.

7752.name: quiet
7752.docs:
Draws the dashes only while files are over the window, for a zone that is a whole
screen and should not look like one until then.

21267.name: Grid
21267.docs: Lays children out in equal-width columns, wrapping into rows.

9787.name: matched
9787.docs: Matching data rows in display order (collapsed groups included).

10441.name: layout
10441.docs:
Where its arrangement lives: read when it changes, and written when someone moves
something. Keep this to bring it back as it was.

196.name: ViewExt

850.name: lifts
850.docs: How far forward each category's slice is, from 0 to 1 (a spring may pass 1).

4701.name: REFRESH
4701.docs:
How often the open panel shows new numbers, in seconds. Its own rebuilds are
frames too, so this stays slow enough not to weigh on what it measures.

8552.name: BottomCenter
8552.docs: The middle of the bottom edge.

13711.name: from
13711.docs: Displacement from the end when it started, in pixels of the scaled content.

14365.name: dock_with
14365.docs: Joins a group of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea), with `{title}` for what shows in it.

18216.name: opener
18216.docs: Opens this row's submenu from the keyboard or a click.

22067.name: most
22067.docs: The most values that can be chosen.

4193.name: scroll_horizontally
4193.docs: Lets a scroll container (see [`Self::scrollable`]) scroll sideways too.

996.name: no_cursor
996.docs: Leaves out the strip or line that marks the category on the chart.

1650.name: MEDIA_AUDIO_WIDTH
1650.docs: The narrowest a recording gets in a message.

23448.name: time
23448.docs: Seconds since start, set by the platform.

16400.name: paint
16400.docs:
Eases this node's own fill, border, shadow, corner radius and text color
whenever a build changes them, like CSS `transition`. Colors travel
through OKLab. Gradients and `Paint::Custom` change at once.

20251.name: on_open
20251.docs: An event was double-clicked, or Enter was pressed on it.

10006.name: Number
10006.docs: A number, with its decimals and the text around it.

21559.name: columns
21559.docs:
Lays the tools out in this many columns (1 by default). With more than one, it
shows only icons.

7463.name: tint
7463.docs: A faint color behind the field, to call attention to it.

1069.name: spoken
1069.docs: The same as the panel, for a screen reader.

4920.name: Stat
4920.docs: A headline number with a label and an optional change indicator.

23521.name: is_dragging
23521.docs:
True while a pointer drag that started on a draggable element (a slider,
a splitter) is in progress. Touch platforms use it to tell drags from scrolls.

7536.name: extensions
7536.docs: The extensions offered, such as `pdf`; empty offers every file.

8844.name: Combobox
8844.docs: A select with a search box: type to filter the options.

2450.name: grid_step
2450.docs: Where an arrow key leads from `index`, in a grid of `count` items in rows of `columns`.

13349.name: ColorWheel

14657.name: Rating

19162.name: category
19162.docs: Contextual pages belong to a colored category and appear on demand.

12768.name: on_commit
12768.docs:
Runs `handler` with the angle when a drag ends or a key or double click changes it: one
step to undo.

23667.name: wire_with
23667.docs:
Like [`Self::wire`], with `before` seeing keys first (a menubar title
opens its menu with Down; menu items switch menus with Left and Right).

21778.name: IconTile

18581.name: is_f2
18581.docs: Whether this is the F2 key, however the platform spells it.

15384.name: landing
15384.docs:
Where a piece taken from `from` lands when dropped in `gap`, if it moves at all. The piece
itself leaves the row: a gap after it is one position less.

1288.name: item_colors
1288.docs: Gives the categories these colors, in order, over those of the series.

12187.name: Eyedropper

5139.name: new
5139.docs: A progress bar at `value`, clamped to 0.0–1.0.

19889.name: TimeScale
19889.docs: What one tick of a [`TimeAxis`] is.

12841.name: new
12841.docs: A crop bound to `area`, in the units of its [space](Self::space).

3904.name: measure
3904.docs: Report the size of the content (see [`BuildCx::measured_content`]).

7755.name: fill
7755.docs: Takes the free space of the parent, for a zone that is a whole screen.

16765.name: adapt
16765.docs: Applies reduced motion: nothing travels, but things may still fade.

16838.name: Collapse
16838.docs:
Animates its content's height as it opens and closes: the "height: auto"
transition. The content stays built until it has finished closing.

9790.name: QueryResult
9790.docs: The output of [`run_query`]: what the grid shows.

2742.name: clipboard
2742.docs: The system clipboard, for copy and paste handlers.

13641.name: frame
13641.docs: The box of the view on screen. Drawing is clipped to it.

10444.name: selection
10444.docs: Where the selected row indices live (otherwise the grid keeps them).

4704.name: PANEL_WIDTH
4704.docs: The panel's width in logical pixels.

12406.name: apply
12406.docs:
`start` with its handle moved by this much along the box's own axes. The opposite handle,
or the pivot, stays where it was on screen.

23305.name: readable
23305.docs:
Text as a screen reader should read it: icon glyphs (private-use code
points) dropped and whitespace collapsed.

6012.name: DockNode
6012.docs: A part of the tree: tabs, or parts side by side or stacked.

13714.name: written
13714.docs: What it wrote last: anything else means someone else moved the view.

14368.name: dock_close
14368.docs: Closes a panel of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea), in a menu.

22070.name: label
22070.docs: The name screen readers announce. Inside a [`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

4123.name: value_moving
4123.docs: A value from [`Self::animated`] is still moving.

18873.name: Link
18873.docs: A label to click and what clicking it does, such as opening a page.

11825.name: ZoomView
11825.docs:
How a picture is being looked at: how much it is enlarged and which part is in the middle.
[`ZoomPanView`], [`ZoomControl`] and [`Minimap`] share one through a `Binding`, and each
changes what it is responsible for.

While `fit` is on, [`ZoomPanView`] keeps the whole content in view and writes the scale
this takes, so the value also reads correctly when the window is resized.

13787.name: ZoomPanWiring
13787.docs: How the parts of a [`ZoomPanView`] see the same picture.

3542.name: RichFn
3542.docs: Draws a node with [`PaintCx`], given its absolute frame.

14441.name: theme_text
14441.docs: A theme editor's group: the colors of text.

4196.name: on_double_click
4196.docs: Calls `handler` on a double click on the node.

16403.name: surface_exit
16403.docs:
The exit fades this node as one surface: its content goes first, over the still
solid panel, and then the panel. Opacity applies to each shape on its own, so
fading all at once would show the panel through its fields, in a gray like metal.
The panel must be the first thing the node paints.

13206.name: light_sum
13206.docs:
Adds colors of light, as overlapping channels of a picture do: red and green make yellow,
all three make gray. On a light theme a pure sum would melt into the page, and it goes
down in brightness instead.

10009.name: GridTableKind
10009.docs: What a column holds, for a file to show it well.

7466.name: error
7466.docs: The first error for the current value, if any.

22216.name: caret_follows_end
22216.docs: A caret at the end stays there when a change makes the text longer.

4923.name: AVATAR_TEXT_TOWARD_INK
4923.docs: How far an avatar's initials go from its color toward the ink.

12625.name: knob_at
12625.docs: Where the handle that turns the box is, on screen.

23524.name: element_count
23524.docs: Number of elements produced by the last build.

20327.name: Move
20327.docs: Along with the pointer; `grab` is how far into the event it was taken.

2380.name: FavoriteToggle

14587.name: recurrence_ends_name
14587.docs: What says when a rule stops.

8847.name: fill
8847.docs: Takes the width of its parent, as other fields of a form do.

13352.name: color
13352.docs: The color this is, at this brightness.

10155.name: has_more
10155.docs: There are more rows after these. Without a total, the grid keeps going while this holds.

21708.name: new
21708.docs: Stars bound to `value`, from none up to the maximum.

14660.name: DaySeparator

19165.name: new
19165.docs: An empty page with this tab title.

12117.name: Strokes
12117.docs: Draws straight lines, each as a sharp quad when it can be and in one path otherwise.

16622.name: Main
16622.docs: Between the main tree and the overlays.

6377.name: left
6377.docs: Puts this in the left dock, `size` logical pixels wide.

21781.name: color
21781.docs: Uses this color instead of the tone's.

15387.name: drag_handler
15387.docs:
The handler for dragging piece `index`, which goes on the piece. Positions are read from the
piece's own frame, which moves with any scroll around it.

1291.name: dots
1291.docs: Draws a dot on each point of a line or a radar.

12190.name: EyedropperState
12190.docs:
What an [`Eyedropper`] and an [`EyedropperArea`] share, and how a color reaches them: from
the area, or from whoever knows the color under the pointer through [`pick`](Self::pick).
Nothing here can read the screen, so the color always comes from the caller.

5142.name: height
5142.docs: Sets the thickness of the bar in logical pixels (6 by default).

12844.name: grow
12844.docs:
How much of the free space along the parent stack it takes: 1 by default, or 0 over a
[stage](Self::stage), which then decides the size.

10301.name: new
10301.docs: Rows that `loader` brings, in chunks of 100, keeping 8 of them.

18657.name: Yearly
18657.docs: Every `interval` years, on the first day's date.

22508.name: row_height
22508.docs: Height of a row of cells in logical pixels. 160 by default.

16768.name: sync_frame
16768.docs:
Moves layout targets to the node's frame, measured without scrolling so
that scrolling does not count as moving. `snap` lands them at once.

A shared object slides from one widget to another. While it stays on the same
one it just follows it, or it would come loose when the layout around it moves.

7177.name: SPLIT_STEP
7177.docs: How far an arrow key moves the bar between panes, in logical pixels.

21927.name: active
21927.docs: Turns the light on or off, as the work starts and ends, without moving the text.

1437.name: BarChart
1437.docs:
A bar chart with labels under each bar and faint gridlines.

Available with the `charts` feature, on by default.

13644.name: custom
13644.docs: Shows what `draw` draws, for content of this size in units of the caller.

6596.name: NumberField

10447.name: on_cell_edit
10447.docs:
Sees each edit before it is kept. An error stays on show, in the toolbar, and the
cell stays open. With it, columns marked [`editable`](GridColumn::editable) can
be edited with a double-click over rows on a server too: the handler saves them.

4053.name: LocalStore
4053.docs:
Widget-local state that survives rebuilds, keyed by widget identity and
call order (see [`BuildCx::use_state`]). Slots of widgets that were not
built in the latest build are dropped.

18803.name: recurrence
18803.docs: How something repeats: a rule, with no UI, that answers on which days.

11755.name: from_bytes
11755.docs: Decodes PNG or JPEG bytes (e.g. from `include_bytes!`).

4707.name: FRAME_BUDGET
4707.docs: The line across the picture: a frame at 120 Hz.

23308.name: SCROLLBAR_WIDTH
23308.docs:
Lines scrolled per wheel notch are converted to pixels by the platform; this
is the width of the overlay scrollbar.

17568.name: text
17568.docs:
An item with only a label, the usual entry of a submenu. Reduced to
icons, its first letter stands in for the icon.

14371.name: dock_options
14371.docs: The button with a panel's menu, with `{title}`.

11828.name: View
11828.docs:
Content of this size where a [`ZoomPanView`](super::ZoomPanView) with the same
[`ZoomView`] shows it. Put the widget exactly over that view.

13790.name: zoom_to
13790.docs:
Goes to this scale keeping the point at `anchor` in place. Reaching the scale that
shows everything turns fit on, so the view goes on following the window.

4199.name: keyed_overlay
4199.docs:
Like [`Self::overlay`], for a layer that must stay the same one when other
layers before it come and go. A plain overlay is told apart by its place among
them, so a new one before it makes it start over, and animate in again.

1656.name: ChatMedia

16406.name: enter
16406.docs: When the node first appears, it starts from this effect.

2310.name: compact
2310.docs:
Shows "1 / 12" between the buttons instead of the page numbers, so that the
buttons stay in the same place whatever the number of pages.

6161.name: edge
6161.docs: The side the new group opens on.

3618.name: phase
3618.docs: Which part of the drag this event is.

22219.name: icon
22219.docs: An icon inside the field, before the text.

8777.name: fuzzy_match
8777.docs: Is every character of `query` found in order in `text`? (case-insensitive)

20330.name: DragKind
20330.docs: What a drag is doing to an event.

2383.name: star
2383.docs: A star instead of a heart.

3037.name: new
3037.docs: A ghost button with this text.

14590.name: recurrence_until
14590.docs: Before the last day, in words.

8850.name: disabled
8850.docs: Turns the control off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

2456.name: Right
2456.docs: The middle of the right edge.

10158.name: new
10158.docs: These rows, with more after them or not.

17860.name: overlay
17860.docs: Floating layers: tooltips, popovers, menus, selects and dialogs.

21711.name: size
21711.docs: Sets the size of a star in logical pixels (18 by default).

7615.name: pick
7615.docs: Asks for files; `done` runs with what was chosen.

15317.name: Sheet
15317.docs: A sheet with its picture, or the promise of one.

20476.name: EventTip
20476.docs: The bubble over a bar: its whole name, when it is and its second line.

6380.name: closed
6380.docs: Starts with these panels closed, ready to be reopened in `place`.

15390.name: adds
15390.docs: The modifier that adds to a selection, by the habit of each system.

1294.name: category_labels
1294.docs: Writes each category beside the data.

12193.name: stay_armed
12193.docs: Stays armed after a pick, to take several in a row (by default it disarms).

5145.name: detail
5145.docs: A line in small text below the bar, such as how many are done.

1948.name: FloatingCorner
1948.docs: A corner of the window, where a [`FloatingPanel`] rests.

12847.name: guide
12847.docs: The lines inside the frame, or none (thirds by default).

10304.name: max_in_flight
10304.docs: How many questions the server gets at once.

21203.name: new
21203.docs: A horizontal strip of `children` (a tuple of up to 12 views or a `Vec`).

14155.name: Stepper
14155.docs:
Decrement / value / increment, for small integer quantities. When focused,
arrow keys step by one and Home / End jump to the limits.

16771.name: end_capture
16771.docs: Stores the picture of an exit node painted at `range` of `scene`.

13574.name: limits
13574.docs: The limits for content that fits at scale `fit`, which is always reachable.

7180.name: split_arrow
7180.docs:
What an arrow key does to the bar between panes: it moves the way the arrow points.
Across a stack, Up and Down still work, as the keys assistive technology sends.

4637.name: first_of_month
4637.docs: The first day of this date's month.

6599.name: money
6599.docs:
A field for money held as a whole number of cents: exact, two decimals,
showing `prefix`, such as `"R$ "`.

10450.name: sort_by
10450.docs: Initial sort; call again to add more sort columns.

859.name: between
859.docs: The two categories it is between, and how far from the first to the second.

2167.name: ORB_KEY
2167.docs: Keeps the sphere's state while the panel comes and goes around it.

6018.name: arrange
6018.docs: Lays an arrangement out in an area of `size`.

17571.name: count
17571.docs:
A count badge at the end of the row (e.g. unread items). Reduced to
icons, a dot on the icon stands for it, and screen readers read it.

21422.name: left
21422.docs: The views at the left end.

14374.name: dock_resize
14374.docs: The bar that resizes a dock, with `{place}`.

7326.name: limits
7326.docs: The smallest and the largest share of the first pane (0.1 and 0.9 by default).

4129.name: foreground
4129.docs:
The text color of the view being built, if a view around it set one with
[`Self::with_foreground`]. Colors do not cascade by themselves, so this is how
a [`Kbd`](crate::Kbd) inside a filled button reads as part of the button.

932.name: ChartIndicator
932.docs: How a row of a [`ChartTooltip`] shows its color.

11831.name: content_size
11831.docs: The size of the content in its own units.

16990.name: rail
16990.docs:
A strip along its inner edge that opens and closes it with a click, for a
sidebar that can close.

14447.name: theme_copy
14447.docs: Copies what changed in a theme.

1659.name: audio
1659.docs:
A recording. The player is built each time the message is shown, so that the clip

frames here, says how to describe the GPU, and opens the panel.

ask for another.

16342.name: border

right next to what it is about, as in a side panel.

14760.name: id

664.name: fill
664.docs: Background, as a theme role (`SurfaceElevated` by default) or a literal color.

1318.name: angles

Where the rings of a radial chart start, in degrees clockwise from the top,

5823.name: BORDER_ZONE

13525.name: ZoomControl

9747.name: level
9747.docs: Nesting depth, 0 for the outermost groups.

6550.name: read_only

14252.name: themes
14252.docs:
Offers the application's own themes in the same three places. Each is told apart by
its name, so it needs one of its own.

7858.name: label
7858.docs: The name screen readers announce, and the picture's alternative text.

18757.name: parse
18757.docs: Reads what [`Self::to_text`] writes; `None` when it is not a rule.

4080.name: hover_readers
4080.docs: The views that asked about the pointer, so that it moving elsewhere rebuilds nothing.

15633.name: bare
15633.docs: Rows, focus and semantics are of the view around it.

6696.name: placeholder

14398.name: TitleBar

22100.name: flip

4153.name: container

15052.name: on_open
15052.docs: Called with an entry on a double click or on Enter.

8004.name: values

19557.name: read_aloud
19557.docs: The text a reader takes in, marks gone and one line per line.

9312.name: Arrangement
9312.docs: What the grid keeps about its columns beyond [`GridQuery`].

15779.name: marks
15779.docs: Says which days have something. It is asked for each day on each build.

23481.name: frame_start
23481.docs: Phase times and shapes when the current frame started.

17087.name: toggle
17087.docs: Opens it if closed, closes it if open.

2991.name: command
2991.docs: This letter or digit with Cmd or Ctrl.

14544.name: step_up

7496.name: ImageField

12001.name: stage
