The view it goes over, such as an [`Image`](crate::Image) or a
[`ZoomPanView`](crate::ZoomPanView), which gives it its size. Without one, put it in
a [`ZStack`](crate::ZStack) with a fixed [size](Self::size).

19703.name: Picture
19703.docs: What the diagram looked like when it was last laid out, relative to its frame.

13309.name: scale
13309.docs: Logical pixels per unit: the zoom.

17160.name: variant
17160.docs: How it sits next to the page ([`SidebarVariant::Standard`] by default).

3718.name: Placement
3718.docs: Where an overlay is placed relative to its anchor.

15271.name: paged
15271.docs: The pages of a document in a column.

12074.name: size
12074.docs: Fixed size in logical pixels, instead of taking the free space.

19776.name: alt
19776.docs:
Describes the diagram for screen readers, in place of its title. Its flows are
read after it.

1829.name: on_link
1829.docs: Called with the address of a link in a [`ChatMessage::formatted`] message.

23627.name: label
23627.docs: A one-line label in the type scale.

6334.name: with
6334.docs: Who stayed in its group as it closed.

3137.name: entries_that_fit
3137.docs:
How many entries of these widths fit in `available`, leaving room for the
overflow menu if some have to go.

14690.name: long_date
14690.docs: A full date, for screen readers: `15 November 2026`, `15 novembro de 2026`.

12147.name: Marquee

8950.name: wide
8950.docs: Appends a field on a row of its own, as wide as the group: a long text, a list.

12801.name: CropArea
12801.docs:
What a [`CropOverlay`] edits: a rectangle of the content and how far it is turned.

The picture stays still and the frame turns over it, since the renderer cannot turn a
picture. A frame turned clockwise by `angle` holds what an upright frame would hold with the
picture turned counterclockwise by it, around the middle of the rectangle.

23700.name: type_name
23700.docs: The name the diagnostics panel shows this view's cost under.

6407.name: parse
6407.docs:
Reads a text from [`Self::to_text`]. What makes no sense but does no harm, such as a panel
twice, an empty group or a share below zero, is put right; what cannot be read is an error,
never a panic.

14763.name: unsaved
14763.docs: It has changes that were not saved.

667.name: selected
667.docs:
Marks it as the chosen one among others: a thicker accent border and a tint of
the accent, with screen readers told which. Works with or without
[`Self::on_click`], and shows even with [`Self::border`] off.

1321.name: hide_tooltip
1321.docs: Says nothing under the pointer and takes no keyboard focus.

5826.name: toggle
5826.docs: How thick the strip that collapses a dock is, or zero without one.

13528.name: centered_on
13528.docs: The same view around this point of the content, from 0 to 1 on each axis.

23846.name: check
23846.docs:
What has to hold to leave this step forward. The error is shown on the step,
and going back never asks.

9750.name: count
9750.docs: Number of data rows in the group.

14909.name: OpenHandler
14909.docs: What runs when an entry is opened.

16871.name: scrim
16871.docs:
The dimmed backdrop of a modal layer, which fades. It goes behind the panel as its
sibling: a fade on the panel's parent would reach the panel too.

15636.name: cross_content
15636.docs: Scrolls across as well, up to this width of content.

12439.name: HANDLE_REACH
12439.docs:
How far from a handle a press still takes it, in pixels: more than it looks, or pressing just
off it would do something else.

13747.name: GLIDE_REST
13747.docs: How near the end a throw counts as finished, in pixels and pixels per second.

6699.name: read_only
6699.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

14401.name: window_restore
14401.docs: The same button of a [`TitleBar`](crate::TitleBar) when the window is maximized.

4156.name: measure_text
4156.docs: Measures `text` without creating a node, e.g. to place a caret.

15055.name: sort
15055.docs: The order, to keep or to set from outside.

8007.name: new
8007.docs: A field with this name in the expression, and this caption on the screen.

1613.name: alt
1613.docs: Describes the code for screen readers, in place of the text it holds.

5464.name: height
5464.docs: Its height, in logical pixels. Without it, it takes the room its parent has.

14474.name: diagnostics_batches
14474.docs: Diagnostics panel: what splits the draw calls.

4229.name: conversation
4229.docs:
Pieces of a conversation: files on their way, a recording to hear, and what to do with
a selection.

1032.name: share
1032.docs: Its share of the whole, already written.

15782.name: columns
15782.docs: How many months go on a line. As many as fit by default.

23484.name: set_viewport
23484.docs: Sets the viewport in logical pixels and the device scale factor.

10042.name: GridTable
10042.docs: The rows of a grid as it stands: the columns showing, the rows matching, in order.

20941.name: wrap
20941.docs:
Moves children that do not fit onto new lines (rows wrap down,
columns wrap right).

2994.name: register
2994.docs: Makes it run `handler` for as long as the view building now is built.

14547.name: Scheduler

7499.name: size
7499.docs: Its size on disk. A file bigger than the request allowed comes with no bytes.

15201.name: new
15201.docs: A strip of `count` cells, with `cell` making the view of each one when it shows.

12004.name: space
12004.docs: Where the content is, and so the units of its coordinates: by default, its own box.

22903.name: new
22903.docs: A timeline of these tracks, top to bottom.

23557.name: anchor_of
23557.docs: For an overlay root, its anchor's frame.

13312.name: thickness
13312.docs: Thickness in logical pixels (18 by default).

17163.name: label
17163.docs:
The name screen readers announce for this landmark (the `navigation`
word of [`Labels`](crate::Labels) by default).

10115.name: offset
10115.docs: The first row wanted, from the start of the result.

21668.name: OverlayBadge

12077.name: keep
12077.docs:
Whether the rectangle stays after the release (it does by default). A box for zooming,
say, goes away as soon as it is used.

19779.name: align
19779.docs: Which column a node goes to, among those its flows allow.

21087.name: description
21087.docs: The line about the page. A long one is cut with an ellipsis.

14693.name: recurrence_summary
14693.docs: A rule in words, with its next days: `Every month, 3 times. Next: 05/11/2026, 05/12/2026`.

19198.name: app_menu

12150.name: segments

23049.name: tree

12804.name: corners
12804.docs:

content.

`height`) and scrolls its children with the wheel or trackpad, showing a
thin scrollbar while they move.

1324.name: legend_at
1324.docs: Where the legend goes (under the chart by default).

5829.name: bottom
5829.docs: The smallest and the largest the bottom dock gets.

16728.name: frame
16728.docs: The node's frame on screen, when it differs from layout.

13531.name: fit_scale
13531.docs: The scale that shows the whole content in the view.

7791.name: most_bytes

743.name: MAX_BAR_WIDTH

21306.name: text
21306.docs: Text in a footer's usual look: small and muted.

18109.name: destructive
18109.docs: Paints the item in the danger color (Delete, Remove…).

816.name: Picture
816.docs: What a drawing looked like when it was last painted, relative to its frame.

5975.name: toggles

16874.name: Segmented

2778.name: color_picker

21379.name: leading

14331.name: selection_one

18836.name: months_after

4740.name: Starting

15639.name: selection

12442.name: KNOB_STEM

13750.name: grab

10699.name: press

15204.name: mode

12007.name: color

22906.name: pixels_per_second

5613.name: reopen_item

13315.name: label

21671.name: inset

14623.name: grid_page

on the UI thread. Canceling gives an empty list.

18474.name: SLIDER_WIDTH

19782.name: no_gradient
19782.docs: Ribbons in the color of their source, instead of going to that of their target.

21090.name: compact

3797.name: fallback_name

19201.name: selected_page
19201.docs: Where the selected page index lives (otherwise the ribbon keeps it).

12153.name: stage
12153.docs:
The view it goes over, such as an [`Image`](crate::Image) or a
[`ZoomPanView`](crate::ZoomPanView), which gives it its size. Without one, put it in
a [`ZStack`](crate::ZStack) with a fixed [size](Self::size).

9610.name: field
9610.docs: The name of the field this column shows, which stays when the title is translated.

10264.name: fail

21163.name: horizontal

a wide canvas). Children keep their own width instead of stretching.

14769.name: unsaved
14769.docs: Whether it has changes that were not saved, shown with a dot.

7721.name: chooser
7721.docs: What opens the system's chooser for these rules, and hands over what comes back.

12880.name: Divider
12880.docs: One over the other, each shown up to a divider that can be dragged.

13534.name: zoomed
13534.docs: At another scale, with the point of the content at `anchor` in the view staying there.

3289.name: menu_trigger
3289.docs: A square button that opens `entries` under it, and takes focus back after.

7794.name: label
7794.docs: The name screen readers announce. Inside a [`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

746.name: SPOKEN_VALUES
746.docs: How many values a screen reader hears before the rest is left out.

5905.name: Split
5905.docs: A pair in a split, of `both` logical pixels in all.

9756.name: ViewRow
9756.docs: A visible row of the grid: a group header or a data row.

18112.name: element
18112.docs:

The label still names the item for screen readers.

11064.name: values_of
11064.docs: The distinct values of a column, with what the filter menu shows for each.

21963.name: ShimmerGlyphs
21963.docs: The shaped text, measured from its own corner, which a paint-only frame cannot shape again.

14915.name: id

1473.name: AreaChart

9829.name: Filter

21382.name: on_maximize
21382.docs: Shows the maximize button, which runs `handler`, as a double click on the bar does.

892.name: paint_candles

which it did does not rest on the color alone.

15642.name: new
15642.docs: A list of `count` rows, with `item` making the view of each one when it shows.

16296.name: on_cancel
16296.docs: Called with a model's position when someone stops its download.

6051.name: DockEdge
6051.docs: A side of a group of tabs, where a split opens.

7359.name: separator
7359.docs: Adds a separator to the current menu (ignored before the first `menu`).

4162.name: label_control

a name of its own, and sets `description` (form fields, tooltips).

22763.name: leading
22763.docs: Something before its label, such as a thumbnail.

19566.name: links_only
19566.docs:

does not use these marks.

5470.name: tab_bar
5470.docs: When a group shows its tabs ([`DockTabBar::Always`] by default).

13172.name: HistogramChannel
13172.docs: One series of a [`Histogram`]: ready-made bins and the color that shows them.

10629.name: new

`label` and the row, such as "Delete Acme", from
[`key_column`](DataGrid::key_column) or else the first column.

14480.name: diagnostics_software_detail
14480.docs: What drawing on the CPU means, and what to do about it.

18985.name: dirty
18985.docs: Set by [`UiWaker::wake`] and cleared by the build it causes.

2346.name: none
2346.docs: The "no color" choice, drawn empty with a bar across it in `danger`.

13245.name: stroke_outline
13245.docs: The outline of a line through `points`: a stroke is a fill of its expanded outline.

10702.name: Zones
10702.docs: Where things landed in the last paint, to tell what a drag is over.

14553.name: histogram_clipped_high

15207.name: cell_width
15207.docs: The width of each cell (96 by default).

22909.name: on_select
22909.docs: Runs when someone selects a block.

2419.name: new
2419.docs: A grid of these colors, each with the name screen readers announce.

17169.name: footer
17169.docs: A view below the content that does not scroll, treated like the header.

10121.name: wants_total
10121.docs:
Whether the total is still unknown. Answer `None` to leave it so: a total can
cost the database more than all the rows ever shown.

14626.name: grid_edit_summary
14626.docs: Opens the editor of a column's summary.

7578.name: FilePickerProvider
7578.docs: Asks the person for files. Platform layers install one with [`crate::Ui::set_file_picker`].

18477.name: FIELD_WIDTH
18477.docs: The width of the number field of [`ValueSlider::field`], in logical pixels.

Picks one option from a list, shown in a field-like trigger. Enter, Space or
an arrow key opens the list with the current option focused; arrows move,
Enter picks, Escape closes, and focus returns to the field.

13391.name: WHEEL_MARGIN
13391.docs: Room around the disc, in logical pixels, for the puck at the edge.

3800.name: new
3800.docs: A node with this role, named by its content when the role allows it.

12156.name: label
12156.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

9613.name: fill

Takes the width the columns leave over, so a wide window has no empty stretch
at the end of the rows. Its [`Self::width`] is what it never goes below.

17315.name: SidebarBrand

The name of an app at the top of a [`Sidebar`], with its mark. Reduced to icons,
only the mark stays, in line with the icons.

21166.name: height
21166.docs: A fixed height instead of filling the parent.

7070.name: required
7070.docs: The field must not be empty.

21820.name: description
21820.docs: The sentence under the title, saying why it is empty or what would fill it.

7724.name: ZONE_STROKE
7724.docs: How thick the dashes of a [`DropZone`] are, in logical pixels, at rest and with files over it.

1330.name: colors_by_category
1330.docs: Whether its categories are what tells colors apart, and not its series.

5181.name: block

14191.name: new
14191.docs: Segments for `options`; `selected` holds the zero-based index.

21893.name: meter

nothing done, and more than the total counts as all of it.

12302.name: angle
12302.docs: How far it is turned clockwise, in degrees.

21312.name: stacked

the breakpoint only knows the window.

14918.name: size
14918.docs: How many bytes it has, if that is known.

1476.name: tone
1476.docs: The line color role (Accent by default; Success, Danger...).

21385.name: maximized

`~struck~`, `` `code` ``, a fenced block of ```` ``` ````, lines that start with `* `, `- `
or `> `, and web addresses, which become links.

It wraps to the width it is offered, between words, and a marked piece stays with the
punctuation around it. Text with nothing to format is drawn as one [`Text`], for the same
cost. Links take the keyboard: Tab reaches them, and Enter or Space opens them. It only
recognizes `http` and `https`, and it hands the address to [`Self::on_link`] instead of
opening anything.

`ravenrs-text` shapes one style per text and embeds neither an italic nor a monospace
font, so italics are told apart by a muted color and code by a chip behind it.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{RichText, Ui};

let text = RichText::new("*Ready:* see `report.pdf` at https://example.com/r")
    .on_link(|address| println!("open {address}"));
let mut ui = Ui::new(text, ravenrs_style::Theme::raven_dark());
ui.update();
```

keyboard. Dragging the ruler moves the playhead, dragging a
[movable](TimelineItem::movable) block moves it, and the ends of a
[trimmable](TimelineItem::trimmable) one change its length.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{Timeline, TimelineItem, TimelineTrack, Tone};

let timeline = Timeline::new(vec![
    TimelineTrack::new("Notes", 34.0, vec![TimelineItem::new(1, 2_000, 3_000, "Callout").movable()]),
    TimelineTrack::new("Film", 56.0, vec![TimelineItem::new(2, 0, 10_000, "Take 1").tone(Tone::Accent)]),
])
.position_ms(4_000)
.on_seek(|ms| println!("{ms}"));
```

14309.name: SankeyChart

nodes are created as they are named. Ribbons go from the color of their source to
that of their target; under the pointer or with the arrow keys, what is connected
stands out and the tooltip says how much. A screen reader hears every flow.

If the flows go in a circle there is no way to draw them, and it says which nodes
the circle goes through, in place of the diagram. Available with the `charts`
feature, on by default.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::SankeyChart;

let budget = SankeyChart::new()
    .title("Budget")
    .flow("Salary", "Rent", 1200.0)
    .flow("Salary", "Food", 600.0)
    .flow("Salary", "Savings", 400.0)
    .flow("Savings", "Funds", 400.0);
```
